data.name: Terrain Master ATV
data.shortDescription: Adds fully functional multiplayer compatible ATVs to the game.
data.description:
Adds a multiplayer compatible, fully functioning, gas powered ATV that you can ride around island.


### Features:


- Supports 1 passenger. Kelvin, Virginia or 1 player can ride along.
- Built for speed and tricky terrain. This ATV can be parked on any slope without sliding away, handles slopes amazingly well and moves faster then golf carts.
- Capable of jumping to help navigate tricky terrain.
- Doesn't damage player made structures. 
- Gas powered. Ideal for nighttime traveling if you know where to get gas.

### Disadvantages it has vs the golf cart

- No radio. 
- No gps.
- Larger hitbox
- Sinks if it lands in deep water.
- If you don't know where to get gas, you may get stranded without it more easily.
- Less light. However lights remain on even when out of the ATV.

### Where to find:

Look near human encampments for ATVs. If you want to test it out, press Shift P to spawn one in. Clients cannot spawn one in multiplayer.

### Where do I get Gasoline?

Youll find jerrycans with gas in cannibal and human camps all over the island. Pick them up and bring them to the ATV where the light bulb is and press E to add gas. All ATVs start with 200 gas. Each gas tank restores 100+ fuel. If you run out of fuel you will be automatically ejected. Fuel respawns in 20 minutes. In multiplayer fuel tanks are consumed by whoever grabs the fuel tank first.

### How does it handle enemies?

The player is immune while in the ATV, but touching cannibals takes away 5 fuel which can get you ejected. Crashing into trees costs you 2 fuel.

https://youtu.be/eYJeHFEZHmY

Note: The download only contains the manifest, license and credits. To get access to this mod dm RegiRockn'roll in the SOTF discord to see if you qualify for early access.
